title: Shopping for Food
description: Four short recordings about buying food: a shopping list, a market, a supermarket announcement and a phone message.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Making a shopping list
parts.intro: You will hear Mum and her son Ben at home before going shopping.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Ben, let's make a shopping list. What do we need?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: We need milk. There's no milk in the fridge.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Yes. Two bottles, please. And we need eggs. Six eggs.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Can we buy some bananas? I eat one every morning.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: OK. Also some tomatoes and a cucumber for the salad.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: What about meat? Dad likes chicken.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: We have chicken in the freezer. But we need rice. A big bag.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: And some biscuits, please!

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: No biscuits today, Ben. We have a lot of fruit at home.

parts.title: Part 2 · At the market
parts.intro: You will hear a woman, Mrs Kim, buying fruit from a seller.

script.speaker: Seller
script.text: Good morning! Fresh fruit today. Can I help you?

script.speaker: Mrs Kim
script.text: Yes, please. How much are the apples?

script.speaker: Seller
script.text: Two pounds a kilo. The oranges are three pounds a kilo.

script.speaker: Mrs Kim
script.text: I'll take two kilos of apples, please.

script.speaker: Seller
script.text: Anything else? The strawberries are lovely today.

script.speaker: Mrs Kim
script.text: They look good, but they're expensive. I'll take one kilo of oranges instead.

script.speaker: Seller
script.text: That's seven pounds altogether. Would you like a bag?

script.speaker: Mrs Kim
script.text: No, thanks. I have my own bag. Here is ten pounds.

script.speaker: Seller
script.text: Thank you. Here's your change, three pounds. Goodbye!

parts.title: Part 3 · A supermarket announcement
parts.intro: You will hear an announcement in a supermarket.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Good afternoon, shoppers. Welcome to Fresh Mart. Here are today's special offers.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Bread is half price this afternoon. Buy a loaf for only one pound.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Cheese and yoghurt are on sale in aisle five. Chicken is in aisle seven.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Children can get a free apple at the fruit counter. Please ask for one.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Please remember, the shop closes at eight o'clock tonight, one hour earlier than usual. Thank you for shopping with us.

parts.title: Part 4 · A phone message
parts.intro: You will hear Linh leaving a message for her brother Minh.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Hi, Minh. It's Linh. I'm at the shop, but I forgot my shopping list!

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Can you help me remember? I have bread and cheese, but I'm not sure about the rest.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Do we need butter? And how many eggs do we need for the cake?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Please look in the fridge and the cupboard. Then call me back.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Also, a lot of people are here, so the queue is long. I think I'll be at least twenty minutes.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: I want to buy some fresh strawberries for the top of the cake, too. They look so nice today.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Thanks, Minh. You're the best!
